subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the GDP of two countries L and M in five different years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe35c6564f5fadfbc1d08a2e4fecdd5eb319a08096cb8f57171ce3ae6061730b.png] 

J1 = The value of average GDP of countries L and M in year Y1.

J2 =The value of average GDP of countries L and M in year Y4.

What is the value of (J1/J2)?
solution: **Calculation:** J1 = The value of average GDP of countries L and M in year Y1 = (205 + 315)/2 = 520/2 = 260 J2 =The value of average GDP of countries L and M in year Y4 = (105 + 115)/2 = 220/2 = 110 The value of (J1/J2) = 260/110 = 2.36
